//: Developer shortcut (Debug menu > Activate EOC).  Spawns Gabriel next to you.  Doesn't check for an existing Gabriel; his real spawn point comes later.

effect.u_message: Survivor Minds debug: Gabriel spawned nearby.

//: Developer shortcut: watch mode.  Spawns a new, unrecruited Gabriel a short way off and makes you unseen, unheard, unscented and unhurtable, with sight through walls, so he acts as if you weren't there.  A follower would just follow you, so don't recruit this one.  EOC_SM_DEBUG_WATCH_STOP ends it.

effect.u_message: Survivor Minds debug: watch mode on.  Gabriel spawned 6-10 tiles away; nothing can see, hear, smell or hurt you.  Stay within about 60 tiles or he stops acting.  Run EOC_SM_DEBUG_WATCH_STOP to end it.

//: Ends watch mode: removes the debug traits EOC_SM_DEBUG_WATCH_GABRIEL gave you.  Gabriel stays where he is.

effect.u_message: Survivor Minds debug: watch mode off.  You can be seen and hurt again.
